protocol.name: fakeland_marks_v1
protocol.copyright: Copyright 2026 the fakeland authors. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description.summary: app instrumentation marks for frame and input attribution

protocol.description:
This protocol lets a client attach instrumentation marks to the commits of its surfaces and to its connection. The compositor records the marks in its trace next to its own timestamps.
The compositor tells the client which of its injected input events comes next on the connection. The client tells the compositor which commit contains the effect of which input event, which app frame a commit carries, and how long the phases of a frame took on the client side.
Every time value in this protocol is on CLOCK_MONOTONIC. A 64-bit id travels as two 32-bit halves: id_hi holds the high 32 bits and id_lo holds the low 32 bits. A timestamp travels as seconds in two 32-bit halves plus a nanosecond remainder, the same encoding wp_presentation uses.
A mark name is a non-empty UTF-8 string of at most 256 bytes.

interface.name: fakeland_marks_manager_v1
interface.description:
The global entry point of the protocol. A client binds it once per connection.
The compositor sends input_event events on every manager object of the client. A client that binds the global twice receives each input_event on both objects.

entry.name: surface_exists
entry.summary: the surface already has a fakeland_surface_marks_v1 object

entry.name: invalid_name
entry.summary: the mark name is empty or longer than 256 bytes

enum.name: input_kind

description.summary: the kind of an injected input event

enum.description: The kind of the input event that an input_event event announces.

entry.name: pointer_motion
entry.summary: wl_pointer.motion, or wl_pointer.enter for the first motion over a surface

entry.name: pointer_axis
entry.summary: wl_pointer axis events: axis, axis_source, axis_value120, axis_stop

entry.name: touch
entry.summary: wl_touch down, motion, up or cancel

entry.name: gesture
entry.summary: zwp_pointer_gestures_v1 swipe, pinch or hold events

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager object. The fakeland_surface_marks_v1 objects that this manager created stay valid. The compositor sends no more input_event events on this object.

request.name: get_surface_marks

description.summary: create a marks object for a surface

request.description:
Creates a fakeland_surface_marks_v1 object for a wl_surface. The marks object holds double-buffered state that applies on the next wl_surface.commit of that surface.
A surface has at most one fakeland_surface_marks_v1 object at a time. If the surface already has one, the compositor raises the surface_exists error.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: the surface that the marks attach to

request.name: mark
request.description:
Records a named mark for the client. The compositor timestamps the mark when it receives the request. The mark belongs to no surface and no commit.
If the name is empty or longer than 256 bytes, the compositor raises the invalid_name error.

event.name: input_event

description.summary: the id of the next injected input event

event.description:
The compositor sends this event immediately before each injected input event that it sends to this client, and in the same flush of the connection. The events that follow on the connection carry the input event with this id, up to the next input_event event. For pointer events, that group ends with wl_pointer.frame.
The client reads this event when it handles the input event that follows. It then passes the id to fakeland_surface_marks_v1.input_handled on the commit that contains the effect of that input event.
Input ids increase over the life of the compositor session. They are unique across all clients.

arg.name: id_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the input id

arg.name: id_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the input id

arg.name: kind
arg.summary: the kind of the input event

interface.name: fakeland_surface_marks_v1

description.summary: instrumentation marks for the commits of a surface

interface.description:
Marks that attach to the commits of one wl_surface. Every request except destroy sets double-buffered state. The compositor applies that state on the next wl_surface.commit of the surface, records it on that commit and clears it.
If the wl_surface is destroyed, every request except destroy raises the no_surface error.

entry.name: invalid_span
entry.summary: a span ends before it begins, or a nanosecond value is 1000000000 or more

entry.name: invalid_name
entry.summary: a span or mark name is empty or longer than 256 bytes

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the marks object. The compositor discards the pending state that no commit applied. The surface can then get a new marks object.

request.name: frame

description.summary: set the app frame id of the next commit

request.description: Sets the app frame id of the next commit. The app chooses the ids. Increasing ids let the compositor detect frames that the app skipped. A second frame request before the commit replaces the first one.

arg.name: id_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the app frame id

arg.name: id_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the app frame id

request.name: input_handled

description.summary: mark an input event as handled by the next commit

request.description: States that the next commit contains the visible effect of the input event with this id. The id comes from fakeland_marks_manager_v1.input_event. A commit can contain the effect of several input events, so the client can send this request more than once before a commit. The compositor ignores a repeated id.

arg.name: id_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the input id

arg.name: id_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the input id

request.name: span

description.summary: attach a client-side phase to the next commit

request.description:
Attaches a named client-side phase of the next commit, for example layout, paint or GPU submit. The begin and end times are on CLOCK_MONOTONIC. The client can send several spans before a commit, and spans can overlap.
If the span ends before it begins, or if a nanosecond value is 1000000000 or more, the compositor raises the invalid_span error. If the name is empty or longer than 256 bytes, the compositor raises the invalid_name error.

arg.name: begin_sec_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the begin seconds

arg.name: begin_sec_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the begin seconds

arg.name: begin_nsec
arg.summary: nanoseconds part of the begin time

arg.name: end_sec_hi
arg.summary: high 32 bits of the end seconds

arg.name: end_sec_lo
arg.summary: low 32 bits of the end seconds

arg.name: end_nsec
arg.summary: nanoseconds part of the end time

request.name: mark

description.summary: attach a named mark to the next commit

request.description:
Attaches a named mark to the next commit. The client can send several marks before a commit.
If the name is empty or longer than 256 bytes, the compositor raises the invalid_name error.
